definition: Research on Language and Computation was a quarterly peer-reviewed academic journal covering research in computational linguistics and natural language processing.
details: It was established in 2003 and ceased publication in December 2010. The journal was published by Springer Science+Business Media.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. Here is the short version: Research on Language and Computation was a quarterly peer-reviewed academic journal covering research in computational linguistics and natural language processing. The part that makes it sing: It was established in 2003 and ceased publication in December 2010. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. And that is Research on Language and Computation — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
